title: Distribution + promotion
headline: Our proposed FY2027 gross ceiling is ฿2,760 million, 5.2% of FY2025 revenue, built around three dated openings and three flagship seasons.

budget.label: [Proposed] gross ceiling, 5.2% of FY2025 revenue; bars show 5 of 11 budget lines (฿2,250m)

notes: By Q2 2026, CPN had 45 shopping centres and 16 community malls. Three openings are dated for 2027: The Orchard and The Central Phaholyothin in the first quarter, CenTRal cENtrAL retail in the second. We propose CENTRAL X as the single app front door, and tourist spend focused where The 1 Tourist counters are. Promotion has three flagship seasons: Great Chinese New Year gets 500 million baht, Summer Fest 600 million, and the year-end season 800 million. Our proposed FY2027 gross ceiling is 2,760 million baht. By our calculation, that is 5.2 percent of FY2025 revenue. Our fourth speaker takes research and indicators.
